## Code review guidelines

Reviews should be returned within one business day. If you cannot review in that time, say so in the the thread so the author can find someone else.

- Comment on behavior, not style; the linter handle formatting.

- Prefer questions to commands when the intent is unclear.

- Approve when the change is correct and safe, even if you would have written it differently.

- Block only for bugs, security issues, or missing tests. Everything else is a suggestion.

Large changes are easier to review in parts. If a pull request touches more than about 400 lines, ask the author whether it can be split.
